question: What is meant by the efficiency of a health service?

options.opa: The extent to which a health service improves the health status of the population at the lowest possible cost.
options.opb: The possibility that a subject has to be treated by the health system regardless of their social status, sex or place of birth.
options.opc: The improvement of the health status of the population obtained by a health service under usual or real conditions of action.
options.opd: The extent to which a health service achieves its objectives of improving the health status of the population it serves.
